subject: SOC 2 Type II coverage & bridge letter needed for renewal — audit window clarification
messages:
From: Andrew Smith <andrew.smith@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenline Procurement <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: latest SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter for renewal (contract renewal 2027-05-15)

Vivek —

Hope you’re doing well. We’re kicking off the renewal procurement for Redwood and need to confirm a few items early in the process so legal and procurement can clear the timeline. Our renewal target is 2027-05-15 (renewal of our annual contract / SOW).

Specifically we need:
- The most recent SOC 2 Type II report you can share (covering the Type II period).
- If you don’t have a current Type II that covers through our renewal date, we need a signed bridge (interim attestation) that covers the gap through 2027-05-15.
- A short evidence checklist so our security team can validate access to artifacts (logs, architecture diagram, change-control evidence).

Can you confirm:
1) The audit window covered by your latest Type II (start/end dates).
2) Whether Redwood can provide a bridge letter that explicitly covers us through 2027-05-15.
3) Any constraints from your side on turnaround for final DocuSign/contract execution (procurement would like a 2-week review window for legal).

Cc'ing procurement so they have this on file. If easier, we can set a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Andrew
Andrew Smith
Head of IT Procurement
Greenline Health
procurement@greenlinehealth.com

Attachments: none (initial request)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Smith <andrew.smith@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter for renewal (contract renewal 2027-05-15)

Andrew —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can support this renewal and I wanted to outline a proposed path so procurement/legal have what they need: 

Plan / next steps: 
1) I’ll share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a draft bridge letter for your review. Marissa (CC) owns sign-off on bridge wording.
2) Laura (CC) will attach a concise evidence checklist for the items your security team typically requests and provide estimated delivery timelines for any artifacts that require approval from our ops team.
3) If procurement is comfortable with the bridge + report, we can treat that as sufficient evidence to proceed with the renewal pending legal review. We typically ask for a 7–10 business day review window from procurement/legal for standard renewals; if you prefer two full weeks we can accommodate that but please confirm.

Quick clarification requests:
- What exact audit-end date would you like the bridge to cover through? You mentioned 2027-05-15; do you need coverage through that date inclusive?
- Are there any special notarization/attachment requirements for your legal team for the bridge?

I’ll get the draft materials to you tomorrow morning (we’ll include a PDF bridge letter and an evidence checklist CSV).

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
Vivek Kulkarni
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0187

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Smith <andrew.smith@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood bridge letter + evidence checklist (draft) — covers through 2027-05-15

Andrew —

Attached are two files: the draft bridge letter and a short evidence checklist tailored for Greenline. Per Vivek’s note, we can sign and deliver the bridge as a PDF. If your legal requires anything further (notarization, wet signature), please flag that now so we can route.

Key points in the draft bridge:
- The attached bridge (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Bridge_2027-03-31.pdf) references our most recent Type II report that covers the period ending 2027-03-31 and provides interim attestation coverage through 2027-05-15 (inclusive).
- The bridge is intended to be accepted alongside the SOC 2 Type II report as sufficient evidence for procurement and legal to complete the renewal.
- If procurement requests alternative wording, we can accept minor redlines; substantive changes will require legal review and may delay turnaround.

Evidence checklist summary (attached CSV):
- System architecture diagram (latest)
- Change control sample (3 records within the audit window)
- Access logs (redacted) for a 30-day sample period
- Incident response summary and remediation documentation for the audit window
- Encryption and key management policy snapshot

Timelines: 
- SOC 2 report and signed bridge: same-business-day turnaround (attached now).
- Evidence items that require ops involvement (logs, change records): we expect to deliver within 3 business days of a formal request.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Bridge_2027-03-31.pdf (PDF, 48KB); Redwood_Evidence_Checklist_Greenline_2027.csv (CSV, 2KB)

If you’d like, I can add an explicit acceptance paragraph for your procurement template.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance & Risk | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Cc: Greenline Procurement <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood bridge letter + evidence checklist (draft) — covers through 2027-05-15

Marissa, Vivek —

Thank you for the quick turnaround and the clear checklist. Procurement and legal reviewed the draft this afternoon and confirm the following: 

1) The SOC 2 Type II report (covering period to 2027-03-31) + the attached bridge letter (coverage through 2027-05-15) are acceptable for us to proceed with renewal sign-off, contingent on the standard contract/SLA language in the SOW.
2) Procurement requests that the bridge include the explicit phrase “interim attestation” (your draft already includes similar language; no further changes required).
3) Legal would like the final PDF bridge and the DocuSign contract package delivered at least 7 business days before our target renewal date (that should be fine).

Next steps for Redwood:
- Please send the finalized signed PDF bridge (we can accept electronically-signed PDF).
- Send the DocuSign packet for the renewal (I’ve attached a DocuSign link placeholder we’ll use to track execution).
- We expect to complete legal review within the 7 business day window; please confirm you can provide any requested evidence within 3 business days once asked.

We’ll plan for final execution by 2027-05-15; procurement will reach out directly if anything else pops up. Thanks for the speedy coordination.

Best,
Andrew
Head of IT Procurement
Greenline Health
procurement@greenlinehealth.com
